title: From joint probability forecasts to selective review: research code and derived evaluation data
description: Reproducibility package for the manuscript "From Joint Probability Forecasts to Selective Review: Decision Value and Calibration Sensitivity in Electricity Monitoring" (Applied Stochastic Models in Business and Industry). The deposit contains the analysis code, the released analysis inputs, the generated result tables and figures, the numerical ledger and the parameter logs, so that every number and figure in the article can be regenerated without refitting the original models. Covered analyses: native workload against early process coverage, the daily-cap and process-cost policy comparison, the controlled marginal-map and dependence-family comparison, the marginal-CDF perturbation screen for ordinary and stateful selection rules, the known-mechanism simulations, and the Danish and price-control transfer endpoints. Also included are the manuscript sources that generate the article and supporting information text, kept as documentation of the document build. The journal submission files, the cover letter and the duplicated table exports are not part of this deposit. No raw provider MW series, weather grids, price series, fitted models or credentials are included. Software is MIT licensed; author-derived data and author-written documentation are CC BY 4.0 with retained third-party terms and attribution as detailed in DATA_LICENSES.md. The evidence is a delayed historical replay, not independently validated live operational availability. Earlier deposits: 1.0.0 at 10.5281/zenodo.23100589, 1.0.1 at 10.5281/zenodo.23168553, 1.1.0 at 10.5281/zenodo.23229890 (superseded, it carried the journal submission files) and 1.1.2 at 10.5281/zenodo.23230336 (the reproducibility package alone).
